description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

The Missive REST API allows developers to manage conversations, messages, contacts, drafts, labels, and analytics programmatically. Authentication uses Bearer tokens (personal access tokens) generated in Missive preferences. The API requires a Productive plan or higher to generate API tokens. Responses are JSON-formatted with HTTP 200 or 201 success codes.
